evidence: Reviewed by an agent from source, against 574875b6 (b6f55d69 after PR 1122 on release 305dfaa4) through the driver-model cutover. For the app: GET /api/drivers and its icon route are new, backend cards add optional fields, and Hermes is no longer a built-in backend, so cards drop it and a stored hermes key reads back unchanged. Old builds keep working: they decode every field they require (card, configuration, ticket and settings changes only add fields), find a backend through an optional lookup, never read tool_kind, and call no removed route. A send on a stored Hermes conversation gets the existing 400 unknown agent backend shape, which old builds show as a failed send. Schema step 1, supervision, install recovery and the executor removals change no response the app reads. Native iOS CI (simulator build and host tests) passed on driver-model, run 44209036980, and PR 1124 had a Mac simulator review. No signed-device test ran.
